title: Bug Hunt inaccessible form
description: Repair a flawed workshop contact form into a keyboard-operable, labeled, validated and mobile-friendly local preview with meaningful errors and honest completion messages.
objectives: Repair label and fieldset relationships on an intentionally broken form
Preserve native email and required-field constraints
Add visible focus styles and live feedback without claiming persistence
Verify invalid and valid keyboard flows and mobile layout in Chromium
rubric: I repaired every field label, choice group and hint relationship.
I tested keyboard focus plus invalid and valid submission flows at mobile width.
I verified the local preview makes no false claim about saving or sending data.
